scope: Fixed outer-stock patches on every292 nonfoil printing;14 native Original planeswalker auto-policy proposals including five foil-only transfer controls. Reference poses remain fixed. Encoded RGB byte distances are diagnostics, not whole-card accuracy or a perceptual color score.
review: The nine nonfoil PW edge references support the same warm stock target as the283 other nonfoil cards. All14 PW proposals reach it through the existing public auto policy; five foil-only printings supply render/transfer controls, not pigment targets.

The proposals also change transparent printing over the stock and small stamp-mount details; they are not pure exterior-only pixel replacements. Recheck the composited frame/paper palette before adoption. There is no per-card color fit or rendering offset.
The complete affine normalization certificate remains independent of this renderer color change. Outer stock does not establish interior-ink calibration. No proposal has been promoted.
